display_name: Horrigan Family Home (Gibson St., Rancho Coronado)
why: The Horrigan family home is the quest-only interior of the street story 'Family Matters' (baseid sts_std_rcr_05): a two-storey house with a basement where the owner's sister, in cyberpsychosis, has killed her. The shell, furniture, front and back doors all sit in the always-loaded exterior sector, so the house is already present and enterable in the clean slate; the one vanilla state worth restoring is the open upstairs bathroom window, the gig's no-skill way in. Vanilla defines no resident population - the only character is the hostile cyberpsycho - so this proposal restores no people and leaves the murder props to the quest-prop cleanup pass.

open_questions: Stand on Gibson St. and try all three ways in. Confirm the front door offers a Technical Ability check, the back door a Body check, and that with the window toggle the front-roof window is open into the upstairs bathroom.

Walk the ground floor and basement and check the murder props. Juliet's corpse, the safe, the freezer, three shard cases, the sedatives, the painting and a blood decal are baked into the always-loaded exterior sector with no hide variant; confirm whether they are visible and whether the clean-slate prop pass removes them.
Look for the gig's leftovers. With the street-story phases omitted there should be no cyberpsycho in the basement, no guard-area alert, no truck at the kerb and no Johnny investigation markers.

Judge whether an empty family home is acceptable here. There is no vanilla resident record (Juliet has none; Rose exists only as the hostile cyberpsycho), so the house reads as unoccupied unless a resident is hand-built.

variant_toggles.why: The location sector ships the 'locked_window' variant on by default, so the upstairs bathroom window is shut. Vanilla's own street-story state hides it (state 0), leaving the open window the front roof leads into - the third entrance for a V without the Technical Ability or Body check. Hiding it restores the house's normal, enterable state without the gig.

deferred_prefab_owner: world streaming (the chosen people need no quest prefab)

proximity_wait.why: The front door on Gibson St. is the normal way in and the only venue device with a resolved entity path; a door entity, not a workspot (rule 8). The variant toggle runs at boot and does not need the proximity branch.
